categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, owner details, extent of land, and encumbrances. The content falls under "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
